properties.headline: Flood Warning issued September 10 at 2:21PM EDT until September 10 at 2:30PM EDT by NWS Charleston WV
properties.description:
The Flood Warning will expire at 230 PM EDT this afternoon for
portions of southeast Ohio, including the following counties, Gallia,
Jackson and Meigs and West Virginia, including the following
counties, Jackson and Mason.

Flood waters have receded. Flooding is no longer expected to pose a
threat. Please continue to heed remaining road closures.

NWSheadline: FLOOD WARNING WILL EXPIRE AT 230 PM EDT THIS AFTERNOON

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued September 10 at 10:17AM EDT until September 13 at 2:00AM EDT by NWS Tampa Bay Ruskin FL
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning is extended for the following rivers in
Florida...

Alafia River At Lithia affecting Hillsborough County.

Horse Creek Near Arcadia at SR 72 affecting DeSoto County.

...The Flood Warning is cancelled for the following rivers in
Florida...

Little Manatee River At Wimauma at US 301 affecting Hillsborough
County.

Manatee River Near Myakka Head at SR 64 affecting Manatee County.

.Rising water levels are expected over the next several days along
the Alafia River At Lithia and Horse Creek Near Arcadia at SR 72 due
to recent heavy rainfall. The Little Manatee River At Wimauma at US
301 and Manatee River Near Myakka Head at SR 64 are no longer
forecast to reach Minor Flood Stage.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Alafia River at Lithia .

* WHEN...From this evening to late Saturday night.

* IMPACTS...At 13.0 feet, River Drive and Squirrel Run Way downstream
of County Road 640 are completely covered by water. One home begins
to flood.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 9:00 AM EDT Thursday the stage was 10.7 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 13.0 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise above flood stage early
tomorrow afternoon to a crest of 13.3 feet early Saturday
morning. It will then fall below flood stage late Saturday
evening.
- Flood stage is 13.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 13.3
feet on 08/26/1945.
- https://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

The next statement will be issued this morning at 1130 AM EDT.

NWSheadline: FLOOD WARNING NOW IN EFFECT FROM THIS EVENING TO LATE SATURDAY NIGHT

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 10 at 12:08PM CDT until September 10 at 3:15PM CDT by NWS New Orleans LA
properties.description:
FFWLIX

The National Weather Service in New Orleans has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Northeastern Livingston Parish in southeastern Louisiana...
Southeastern St. Helena Parish in southeastern Louisiana...
Southwestern Tangipahoa Parish in southeastern Louisiana...

* Until 315 PM CDT.

* At 1208 PM CDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain over Hammond, moving northwest at 10 mph. Between 2 and
4 inches of rain have fallen. Additional rainfall amounts of 1 to 3
inches are possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing
or expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Hammond, Amite, Ponchatoula, Amite City, Independence, Roseland,
Albany, Springfield, Montpelier, Natalbany, Robert and Tickfaw.

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued September 10 at 10:48AM EDT until September 10 at 2:30PM EDT by NWS Charleston WV
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...North Central Gallia County in southeastern Ohio...
Jackson County in southeastern Ohio...
West Central Meigs County in southeastern Ohio...
Southeastern Vinton County in southeastern Ohio...

* WHEN...Until 230 PM EDT.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying
and flood-prone locations is imminent or occurring.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 1045 AM EDT, the public reported flooded roadways and multiple
water rescues in the warned area due to thunderstorms earlier
this morning. Flooding is already occurring. Between 4 and 6
inches of rain have fallen.
- Flooding impacts will continue, with additional rounds of light
rainfall possible.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Jackson, Wellston, Rio Grande, Coalton, Vinton, Wilkesville,
Salem Center, Petersburg, and Dexter.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

Report flooding to the National Weather Service by calling toll free,
800 401 9535, when you can do so safely.

properties.areaDesc: Coastal waters from Chokoloskee to Bonita Beach FL out 20 NM
properties.headline: Special Marine Warning issued September 10 at 2:02PM EDT until September 10 at 2:45PM EDT by NWS Miami FL
properties.description:
SMWMFL

The National Weather Service in Miami has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Coastal waters from Chokoloskee to Bonita Beach FL out 20 NM...

* Until 245 PM EDT.

* At 202 PM EDT, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing
waterspouts was located over Naples, moving northwest at 15 knots.

HAZARD...Waterspouts and wind gusts 34 knots or greater.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Waterspouts can easily overturn boats and create locally
hazardous seas. Small craft could be damaged in briefly
higher winds and suddenly higher waves.

* Locations impacted include...
Naples and Bonita Shores.
properties.instruction:
Move to safe harbor until hazardous weather passes.

Frequent lightning is occurring with this storm. If caught on the
open water stay below deck if possible, keep away from ungrounded
metal objects.

Report severe weather to the Coast Guard or the National Weather
Service. You can also share your report with NWS Miami on Facebook
and Twitter.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued September 10 at 1:16PM CDT until September 10 at 2:00PM CDT by NWS Norman OK
properties.description:
SVROUN

The National Weather Service in Norman has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
North central Love County in southern Oklahoma...
Southeastern Carter County in southern Oklahoma...

* Until 200 PM CDT.

* At 116 PM CDT, a severe thunderstorm was located near Ardmore,
moving east at 25 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind damage
to roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Ardmore, Lone Grove, Dickson, Lake Murray, and Overbrook.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.
